goals.description: Continue practicing brief coping skills before an approach task.

Coordinate with the individual clinician regarding the group experience so that future attendance can be supported without assuming that participation in a group exercise reflects completion of the patient's own work task.
At least 3 therapy days and at least 150 minutes of patient-present therapy in each Monday–Sunday week.
Improve daily activity and task initiation. Select manageable activities, track attempts, and review barriers.
Improve coping with anxiety and disrupted sleep. Practice grounding or paced-breathing and establish consistent morning routine.
Support a workable return to employment. Address avoided communication and gradual preparation.

events.decision_notes: The explicit correction (BH-D103) supersedes the departure time in the original roster, changing it from 11:30 to 11:15. Patient contact occurred in two segments separated by a network disconnect. The disconnect interval is placed in excluded_intervals to denote the gap without patient therapy.

findings.detail: d259dee97e455694: candidate patient intervals [{'start': '10:00', 'end': '10:45'}, {'start': '11:00', 'end': '11:30'}] were service-level time; The extracted intervals are derived from the group's scheduled time minus the stated group break (10:45-11:00). The source only establishes the group's and facilitator's activity window and explicitly notes attendance is maintained on a separate roster. It does not provide explicit patient-specific clock times for arrival/departure or direct contact to confirm the patient was present for the full 10:00-10:45 and 11:00-11:30 durations.

Attendance is noted to be recorded on a separate desk roster, so these intervals describe the service's window rather than the patient's verifiable actual time.
